Cargo: Records the player's inventory across ship or SRV, listing items with counts, stolen status, and mission associations
ClearSavedGame: Triggered when a player resets their game, containing commander name and player ID
Commander: Written at the start of the LoadGame process with commander name and player ID
Loadout: Documents current ship configuration including modules, health, fuel capacity, and engineering modifications
Materials: Lists player's raw materials, manufactured items, and scanned data collections
Missions: Displays active, failed, and completed missions with expiration times
NewCommander: Generated when creating a new commander, including selected starter package
LoadGame: At startup, when loading from main menu into game with comprehensive player and ship state data
Passengers: Contains passenger manifest with mission IDs, types, VIP status, and counts
Powerplay: Records power allegiance details if the player has pledged to a power
Progress: Shows percentage progress toward next rank across various skill categories
Rank: Displays current ranks across combat, trade, exploration, and faction categories
Reputation: Player's reputation standings with superpowers on a -100 to +100 scale
Statistics: Comprehensive gameplay statistics covering finances, combat, crime, and achievements
ApproachBody: Triggered when in Supercruise, and distance from planet drops to within the 'Orbital Cruise' zone
Docked: Occurs when landing at landing pad in a space station, outpost, or surface settlement
DockingCancelled: Recorded when the player cancels a docking request
DockingDenied: Logged when the station denies a docking request
DockingGranted: Written when a docking request is granted
DockingRequested: Triggered when the player requests docking at a station
DockingTimeout: Occurs when a docking request has timed out
FSDJump: Recorded when jumping from one star system to another
FSDTarget: Written when selecting a star system to jump to
LeaveBody: Triggered when leaving a planet's orbital cruise zone
Liftoff: Occurs when taking off from planet surface
Location: Written at startup, or when being resurrected at a station
StartJump: Logged at the start of a Hyperspace or Supercruise jump
SupercruiseEntry: Triggered entering supercruise from normal space
SupercruiseExit: Occurs leaving supercruise for normal space
Touchdown: Written landing on a planet surface
Undocked: Recorded upon liftoff from a landing pad in a station, outpost or settlement
NavRouteClear: Written when the current plotted nav route is cleared
Bounty: Player is awarded a bounty for a kill
CapShipBond: Player receives a reward for destroying a capital ship in combat
Died: Player was killed by either a single opponent or a wing
FactionKillBond: Player rewarded for taking part in a combat zone
FighterDestroyed: Records when a ship-launched fighter is destroyed
HeatDamage: Triggered when taking damage due to overheating
HullDamage: Triggered when hull health drops below a threshold (20% steps)
Interdicted: Player was interdicted by player or npc
Interdiction: Player has (attempted to) interdict another player or npc
PVPKill: Recorded when this player has killed another player
ShieldState: Triggered when shields are disabled in combat, or recharged
ShipTargeted: When the current player selects a new target
SRVDestroyed: Triggered when the player's SRV is destroyed
UnderAttack: Triggered when under fire (same time as the Under Attack voice message)
CodexEntry: Records when a new discovery is added to the Codex, including entry details, location, and traits
DiscoveryScan: Logged when using the discovery scanner, and new body discoveries are displayed in the cockpit info window
Scan: Generated during basic or detailed discovery scan of a star, planet or moon with comprehensive celestial body data
FSSAllBodiesFound: Written after having identified all bodies in the system
FSSBodySignals: Records signal counts found during a Full Spectrum Scan of a starsystem
FSSDiscoveryScan: Created when performing a full system scan (Honk)
FSSSignalDiscovered: Logged when zooming in on a signal using the FSS scanner
MaterialDiscovered: Written when a new material is discovered
MultiSellExplorationData: Generated when selling exploration data in Cartographics, a page at a time
NavBeaconScan: Written before scan data for system bodies is recorded
BuyExplorationData: Triggered when buying system data via the galaxy map
SAAScanComplete: Logged after using the Surface Area Analysis scanner
SAASignalsFound: Written when using SAA scanner on a planet or rings
ScanBaryCentre: Records orbital parameters of binary star systems' barycentre
SellExplorationData: Generated when selling exploration data in Cartographics
Screenshot: Written when a screen snapshot is saved
AsteroidCracked: When the player has broken up a 'Motherlode' asteroid for mining
BuyTradeData: When buying trade data in the galaxy map
CollectCargo: When scooping cargo from space or planet surface
EjectCargo: Triggered when jettisoning cargo into space
MarketBuy: When purchasing goods in the market
MarketSell: When selling goods in the market
MiningRefined: When mining fragments are converted unto a unit of cargo by refinery
CargoDepot: When collecting or delivering cargo for a wing mission, or if a wing member updates progress
CommunityGoal: When the game retrieves info on community goals from the server, and the data has changed since last time
CommunityGoalDiscard: When opting out of a community goal
CommunityGoalJoin: When signing up to a community goal
CommunityGoalReward: When receiving a reward for a community goal
CrewAssign: When changing the task assignment of a member of crew
CrewFire: When dismissing a member of crew
CrewHire: When engaging a new member of crew
EngineerContribution: When offering items cash or bounties to an Engineer to gain access
EngineerProgress: When a player increases their access to an engineer
FetchRemoteModule: When requesting a module is transferred from storage at another station
Market: When accessing the commodity market in a station
MaterialTrade: When exchanging materials at the Material trader contact
ModuleBuy: When buying a module in outfitting
ModuleRetrieve: When fetching a previously stored module
ModuleSell: When selling a module in outfitting
ModuleStore: When storing a module in Outfitting
ModuleSwap: When moving a module to a different slot on the ship
Outfitting: Written when accessing the outfitting menu
RedeemVoucher: When claiming payment for combat bounties and bonds
RestockVehicle: When purchasing an SRV or Fighter
ScientificResearch: When contributing materials to a research community goal
SearchAndRescue: When delivering items to a Search and Rescue contact
SellDrones: When selling unwanted drones back to the market
SetUserShipName: When assigning a name to the ship in Starport Services
Shipyard: When accessing shipyard in a station
ShipyardBuy: When buying a new ship in the shipyard
ShipyardNew: After a new ship has been purchased
ShipyardSell: When selling a ship stored in the shipyard
ShipyardTransfer: When requesting a ship at another station be transported to this station
ShipyardSwap: When switching to another ship already stored at this station
StoredModules: When first visiting Outfitting, and when the set of stored modules has changed
TechnologyBroker: When using the Technology Broker to unlock new purchasable technology
ClearImpound: When clearing the impound off of one of your ships
PowerplayCollect: When collecting powerplay commodities for delivery
PowerplayDefect: When a player defects from one power to another
PowerplayFastTrack: When paying to fast-track allocation of commodities
PowerplayJoin: When joining up with a power
PowerplaySalary: When receiving salary payment from a power
PowerplayVote: When voting for a system expansion
PowerplayVoucher: When receiving payment for powerplay combat
AppliedToSquadron: Triggered when a player applies to join a squadron
DisbandedSquadron: Recorded when a squadron is disbanded
InvitedToSquadron: Occurs when a player receives an invitation to a squadron
JoinedSquadron: Logged when a player successfully joins a squadron
KickedFromSquadron: Triggered when a player is removed from a squadron
LeftSquadron: Recorded when a player voluntarily departs from a squadron
SharedBookmarkToSquadron: Occurs when a player shares a bookmark with their squadron
SquadronCreated: Logged when a new squadron is established
SquadronDemotion: Triggered when a player's rank decreases (includes OldRank and NewRank parameters)
SquadronPromotion: Recorded when a player's rank increases (includes OldRank and NewRank parameters)
SquadronStartup: Written at game startup, to identify the player's squadron
WonATrophyForSquadron: Triggered when a squadron wins a trophy
CarrierJump: Logged when a player docked at a fleet carrier experiences the carrier jumping to a new location
CarrierBuy: Player has bought a fleet carrier with details on purchase location, price, and callsign
CarrierStats: Triggered when owner opens carrier management, containing comprehensive carrier data including fuel, jump range, and crew information
CarrierJumpRequest: Recorded at the time the player requests the jump, not the jump itself with destination and departure time details
CarrierDecommission: Logged when a player initiates carrier decommissioning, including scrap refund amount
CarrierCancelDecommission: Records cancellation of a pending decommission request
CarrierBankTransfer: Tracks credit transfers between player and carrier accounts
CarrierDepositFuel: Documents fuel donations to the carrier from any player
CarrierCrewServices: Records crew activation, deactivation, pausing, resuming, or replacement operations
CarrierFinance: Reflects changes to tax rate or reserve balance settings
CarrierShipPack: Tracks purchasing, selling, or restocking ship modules for the carrier
CarrierModulePack: Uses the same format as CarrierShipPack for module inventory management
CarrierTradeOrder: Logged when the owner initiates commodity buying, selling, or cancels trade orders
CarrierDockingPermission: Records modifications to docking access restrictions
CarrierNameChanged: Documented when a carrier's name or callsign is altered
CarrierJumpCancelled: Recorded when a scheduled jump is cancelled
Backpack: Lists the contents of the backpack, in a separate backpack.json file
BackpackChange: Triggered when suit backpack contents change, recording items added or removed
BookDropship: Logged when signing up to fight at a recruitment desk
BookTaxi: Logged when booking a taxi transport
BuyMicroResources: Recorded when purchasing microresources from vendors
BuySuit: Logged when buying a new suit
BuyWeapon: Logged when purchasing a new hand weapon
CancelDropship: Triggered when a player cancels their combat zone journey
CancelTaxi: Logged if the player cancels a booked taxi trip
CollectItems: Occurs when picking up items from the ground
CreateSuitLoadout: Logged when the player creates a new suit loadout
Disembark: Logged when the player steps out of a ship or SRV
DropShipDeploy: Triggered when exiting a shuttle at a conflict zone
Embark: Logged when a player (on foot) gets into a ship or SRV
FCMaterials: Documents fleet carrier bartender material trading
LoadoutEquipModule: Logged when a player adds a weapon to a suit loadout
LoadoutRemoveModule: Logged when a player removes a weapon from a suit loadout
ScanOrganic: Logged when the player uses the Organic Sampling Tool to scan, log or analyse organic discoveries
SellMicroResources: Logged when a player sells Microresources for cash
SellSuit: Logged when a player sells a flight suit
SellWeapon: Logged when a player sells a hand weapon
ShipLocker: Lists the contents of the ship locker
SwitchSuitLoadout: Logged when a player selects a different flight suit from the ship's locker
TransferMicroResources: Records moving items between backpack and ship locker
TradeMicroResources: Logged when the player exchanges owned microresources to receive some other type
UpgradeSuit: Logged when the player upgrades their flight suit
UpgradeWeapon: Logged when the player upgrades a hand weapon
UseConsumable: Occurs when using an item from the player's backpack inventory
AfmuRepairs: Triggered when repairing modules with the Auto Field Maintenance Unit
ApproachSettlement: Occurs when approaching a planetary settlement
ChangeCrewRole: Logged when a crew member switches their assigned role
CockpitBreached: Recorded when the cockpit canopy is compromised
CommitCrime: Triggered when a crime is recorded against the player
Continued: Written when the journal file reaches 500k lines and restarts
CrewLaunchFighter: Logged when a crew member launches a fighter
CrewMemberJoins: Triggered when another player joins your ship's crew
CrewMemberQuits: Recorded when a crew member leaves
CrewMemberRoleChange: Logged when a crew member changes roles
CrimeVictim: Triggered when another player commits a crime against you
DatalinkScan: Recorded when scanning a data link
DatalinkVoucher: Triggered when a datalink scan generates a reward
DataScanned: Logged when scanning certain data link types
DockFighter: Recorded when docking a fighter with the mothership
DockSRV: Triggered when docking an SRV with the ship
EndCrewSession: Logged when the captain disbands the crew
FighterRebuilt: Recorded when a fighter is rebuilt in the hangar
FuelScoop: Triggered when scooping fuel from a star
Friends: Logged when friend status changes or at startup
JetConeBoost: Recorded when collecting enough material for a jump boost
JetConeDamage: Triggered when jet cone damage occurs to a module
JoinACrew: Logged when joining another player's ship
KickCrewMember: Triggered when forcing a crew member to leave
LaunchDrone: Recorded when deploying any drone or limpet type
LaunchSRV: Triggered when deploying an SRV onto a planet
ModuleInfo: Recorded when cockpit module info changes
Music: Logged when game music mood transitions
NpcCrewPaidWage: Recorded when crew members receive wages
NpcCrewRank: Triggered when a crew member's combat rank increases
Promotion: Logged when the player's rank increases
ProspectedAsteroid: Recorded when using a prospecting drone
QuitACrew: Triggered when leaving another player's crew
RebootRepair: Logged when using the reboot repair function
ReceiveText: Recorded when receiving a text message
RepairDrone: Logged when a repair drone fixes ship damage
ReservoirReplenished: Triggered when fuel transfers between tanks
Resurrect: Recorded when the player restarts after death
Scanned: Logged when the player's ship is scanned
SelfDestruct: Recorded when using the self-destruct function
SendText: Logged when sending a text message to another player
Synthesis: Triggered when using synthesis to repair or rearm
SystemsShutdown: Logged when ship systems shut down
USSDrop: Recorded when dropping from supercruise at a USS
VehicleSwitch: Logged when switching between ship and fighter control
WingAdd: Triggered when another player joins the wing
WingInvite: Logged when receiving a wing invitation
WingJoin: Recorded when this player joins a wing
CargoTransfer: Triggered when transferring cargo between vessels
SupercruiseDestinationDrop: Logged when dropping from supercruise at a target
